name: Eleusinian Mysteries
summary: The great autumn initiation at Eleusis: nine days from the gathering in Athens to the night of the Telesterion, promising the initiate a kinder portion in the world below — founded, the hymn says, by Demeter herself as she mourned for Persephone.
testimonia: Homeric Hymn to Demeter 470–482 (the founding of the rites)
